source.note: axes: x to port, y up from the laden waterline (deck floor 9.1), z forward from amidships; yard = z + 17.25, height above keel = y + 1.9

rooms.what: Emergency-generator room: the 40 kVA emergency generator, the emergency switchboard, the 24 V batteries and their chargers, a 60 L day tank, louvres
rooms.why: Power when the main board is dead; its door opens to the open deck only

rooms.what: CO₂ room and fire-control station: four 45 kg CO₂ bottles, the release cabinet, the remote fan stops and fuel quick-closing valves, two firemen’s outfits
rooms.why: Fire in the engine room is fought from outside it; its door opens to the open deck only

rooms.what: Crew cabin, two berths: the bosun and the oiler; bunk beds, lockers, a fold-down desk
Mess room: a table for six, a television, a kettle, the duty board and the muster list
rooms.why: Where the crew eat and the watch is handed over

rooms.what: Galley: a three-plate range, the rice cooker, a fridge-freezer, a sink, a hood, the provision locker, a hatch to the mess
rooms.why: The cook’s; the kiosk’s hot water too
Primary home with Thuan on Kitano-jima

rooms.what: Master’s cabin: a desk, a bunk along the corridor’s wall, the ship’s papers and the safe; the crew stair’s trunk walled off in its outboard forward corner
The crew’s corridor down the middle, from their own door aft onto the bridge deck’s platform (they come up the open deck’s ladders) to the wheelhouse
rooms.why: The crew’s way to their rooms and to the bridge, apart from the passengers

rooms.what: Wheelhouse: the steering stand (wheel, non-follow-up lever, autopilot); two engine levers and the thruster lever at the centre and on both wing consoles; the radar; the magnetic compass periscope; VHF with DSC; the ship’s telephone; the NAVTEX printer; the echo sounder; the GPS display; the chart table with its drawers and red lamp; the navigation-light panel; the fire panel; the PA and general alarm; the ramp lamps; the whistle button; the searchlight control; the wipers; a clock, a barometer, an inclinometer; the log desk; the master’s high chair
rooms.why: She is conned from here and from the wings

rooms.what: Bridge wing, port, open: a wing console with the engine and thruster levers, the port sidelight at its end
Bridge wing, starboard, open: a wing console, the starboard sidelight at its end, the float-free EPIRB
